sources.leaguepedia: Leaguepedia Cargo API (lol.fandom.com): top-tier League of Legends events 2011–2026, champions, runners-up and their players
sources.compiled: Compiled from public records for this game (CS Majors, The International, VCT Masters / Champions, HLTV player of the year); not checked against a live source in this export
sources.leaguepedia_mvp: Leaguepedia Cargo API: MatchSchedule MVP of the last series between each LoL champion and runner-up (finals MVP)
sources.rosters_fix: Champion/runner-up rosters of more than nine names (merged stage records) removed; the teams are kept

coverage: League of Legends: Worlds, MSI, First Stand, EWC, IEM and every top domestic league; CS: every Major; Dota 2: every TI; VALORANT: Masters and Champions. Not included: Honor of Kings (the game's HoK players are fictional), Wild Rift, MLBB and the other games' domestic leagues.
